snippet.title: Scrubbin' Trubble Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Hold on to your bubbles! Scrubbin' Trubble is a co-operative turn-based roguelike clean-em-up for 1 - 4 players coming later this year to Steam from new indie game studio, Odd Object.

Wishlist Scrubbin' Trubble on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3276700
Website: http://www.scrubbintrubble.com/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/oddobject.zone

You and your buddies each play one of six unique character classes to deal with some of the nastiest grime you’ve ever seen… and this filth fights back. Sometimes to get clean, you gotta get dirty. Go it alone or team up with up to three other players to wipe out the Nasties infesting every inch. Think strategically and defeat foes to earn powerful upgrades for the whole team and their special abilities, working your way from one floor to the next.
